                     .replace("split_factor", str(frozen_params["split_factor"])) \
                     .replace("hours_per_generation", str(frozen_params["hours_per_generation"])) \
                     .replace("days", str(frozen_params["days"]))

        "oracle_payload": frozen_params
    }
